visualReview.scope: Exterior render integrity; maximum fidelity remains pending.
visualReview.notes: Inspected all 17 current portable views. Closed the projecting lobby roof and returns before final capture, tightened overview framing, and used the existing sky-reflection option for physically metallic surfaces. Individual punched windows, stepped corners, terrace, folded pyramid louvres and four-wing entrance doors render. Fine roof slats show aliasing at distant viewpoints; this is retained for future LOD work.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 17 current viewer frames, including full-resolution entrance, window-detail and north-up placement images. Four canonical graphs each load once; no embedded images. Unloading leaves zero live model geometries. The fixture uses flat terrain and cannot establish actual street contact.

geographicReview.notes: Exact Q503477 match to OSM way 5986754. Lower envelope follows the retained footprint; the tower is offset X=-2.65 m within it, and west terrace faces west. Heading -0.172600059102 and anchor [-0.019514156,51.50493389] are map-derived. Signed current facade fit, canopy extents and real pavement datum still require verification.

fidelityReview.notes: Published 1.8 x 2.75 m windows, typical 4.11 m storeys and 4.71 m level 50 are used directly. The recipe distinguishes 56.9/49.8 m internal dimensions from reconstructed external plans. Lower-floor datum, nine-door distribution, pyramid dimensions/louvre profile, current entrance elevations and roof equipment are not fully measured. The architect’s 235 m and council’s 236 m height datums remain unresolved. Do not count this model as completed.
